notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least four life this turn.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mysterious Limousine, adding {C}{C}.
Sludge Strider triggers, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life and cause an opponent to lose 1 life.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, converting it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and returning Mysterious Limousine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it and Sludge Strider trigger.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Ratchet until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Sludge Strider trigger, choosing not to pay.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mysterious Limousine, adding {C}{C}.
When Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, Ratchet returns to the battlefield from exile as Ratchet, Field Medic.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer
